issue: The INTERRUPTION bullet defers a concrete decision to impl time: '...send Telnyx's clear equivalent (verify Telnyx's clear analog against media-streaming docs at impl time)'. This information is not actually unknown -- Telnyx's Media Streaming API documents a `{"event":"clear"}` message that stops playback and clears the outbound queue (this is standard, already-researched knowledge in this project's own voice-agent reference notes). Per project HARD RULE 0.7 ('スペックに「任意」「optional」「推奨」禁止。全て MUST'), a spec should not carry a 'verify at impl time' placeholder for a fact that is already knowable and load-bearing for the barge-in behavior central to a natural two-way conversation.

fix: Replace the hedge with the concrete message: on VAD speech-start while TTS is playing, stop the local playback loop AND send `{"event":"clear"}` over the Telnyx carrier ws (per Telnyx Media Streaming docs, 'Sending RTP stream' / interruption section) to flush any already-queued outbound audio.
